MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '71024-7'})
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv
ORDER BY inv.version DESC
WITH s, head(collect(inv)) AS currentInv

// Direct parts from the set's own inventory (excluding spare)
OPTIONAL MATCH (currentInv)-[hp:HAS_PART]->(p:Part)
WHERE hp.is_spare = false
WITH s, currentInv, sum(hp.qty) AS directQty

// Nested sets and minifigs in the set's inventory
OPTIONAL MATCH (currentInv)-[cs:CONTAINS_SET]->(nestedSet:Set)
OPTIONAL MATCH (currentInv)-[cm:CONTAINS_MINIFIG]->(mf:Minifig)
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, 
     collect({item: nestedSet, qty: cs.qty, type: 'set'}) AS nestedSets,
     collect({item: mf, qty: cm.qty, type: 'minifig'}) AS nestedMinifigs

// For each nested set, get its current inventory and recursively compute its total parts
UNWIND nestedSets AS ns
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, ns, nestedMinifigs
WHERE ns.item IS NOT NULL
MATCH (ns.item)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(nestedInv:Inventory)
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, ns, nestedMinifigs, nestedInv
ORDER BY nestedInv.version DESC
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, ns, nestedMinifigs, head(collect(nestedInv)) AS nestedCurrentInv
OPTIONAL MATCH (nestedCurrentInv)-[hp2:HAS_PART]->(p2:Part)
WHERE hp2.is_spare = false
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, ns, nestedMinifigs, sum(hp2.qty) AS nestedSetPartQty
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, nestedMinifigs, ns.qty * nestedSetPartQty AS nestedSetContribution

// For each minifig, get its inventory parts
UNWIND nestedMinifigs AS nm
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, nestedSetContribution, nm
WHERE nm.item IS NOT NULL
MATCH (nm.item)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(mfInv:Inventory)
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, nestedSetContribution, nm, mfInv
ORDER BY mfInv.version DESC
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, nestedSetContribution, nm, head(collect(mfInv)) AS mfCurrentInv
OPTIONAL MATCH (mfCurrentInv)-[hp3:HAS_PART]->(p3:Part)
WHERE hp3.is_spare = false
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, nestedSetContribution, nm, sum(hp3.qty) AS mfPartQty
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, nestedSetContribution, nm.qty * mfPartQty AS mfContribution

// Aggregate contributions
WITH s, currentInv, directQty, 
     sum(nestedSetContribution) AS totalNestedSetQty,
     sum(mfContribution) AS totalMinifigQty
WITH directQty, totalNestedSetQty, totalMinifigQty,
     directQty + totalNestedSetQty + totalMinifigQty AS totalQty
RETURN round(((totalNestedSetQty + totalMinifigQty) * 100.0) / totalQty, 2) AS percentage
